{{Top|leg}}
'''''Riirdo''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The Cargo ferry, along with ''[[Filcher]]'' under escort of [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] [[Devil (Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle)|''Devil'']] had stolen two [[Class-A cargo container|containers]] of munitions from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] armory. They arranged a rendezvous with a pair of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ferries ''[[Redbill]]'' and ''[[Wippet]]'', which would have [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] as their own escorts.

However, Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] arrived to reclaim the munitions and arrest the pirates. The pirates escorts were destroyed and both ferries were disabled, the transports boarded ''Filcher'' and ''Riirdo'' seized the cargo and arrested the crews. The ferries were destroyed afterwards. The event was recorded and recreated for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]
